blocks.text: Most RAG stack failures map to a known cause: wrong addressing, one-time initialization, schema/model drift, memory, or stale images and volumes.

rows: Not on a shared network / db down
Volume initialized with an old password; newline in secret
DB stamped by a revision not in this image
Rebuild the correct branch; alembic history
Warm up in lifespan; cache volume
Unpinned model revision or chunking drift
Pin; store model version with vectors

items: `docker compose ps`: which service, which exit code.
`docker compose logs <svc>`: the first error, not the last.
From the caller: DNS → TCP → protocol.
State: volume age, `alembic current`, collection dimension and distance.
Fix, recreate, rerun the smoke test.

blocks.text: Q: "The API can't authenticate to Postgres after you changed the password. Why?" A: "POSTGRES_PASSWORD only applies when the data directory is initialized; the existing volume keeps the old password. Change it with ALTER USER (or reset the volume in dev), and check the secret file for a trailing newline."

items: Addressing and one-time init cause most failures.
Model/dimension drift is a schema problem.
Memory scales with workers and batches.
Confirm image, volumes and migrations state.
